summary: Embedded dashboard trace links return 403 after retention backfill expires session tokens
description:
Issue summary:
Customer reports that when they click trace links exported from an embedded dashboard, they receive 403 Forbidden. The problem started after a scheduled retention backfill job ran overnight (index compaction + session tombstone GC). Impact: analysts cannot jump from dashboard rows to live trace views; several alerts are firing for missing trace context.

Impact:
- Multiple 403s observed for trace links originating from embedded dashboards shared externally.
- Affects BrightCart enterprise org; primary analytics workflows blocked for reporting dashboard owners.
- Not all traces 403; only links generated from panels with the 'preserve-session-on-export' toggle appear affected.

Observed timeframe: First reported 2026-03-12 07:40 UTC. Customer noticed after our retention backfill window (2026-03-12 02:00–05:00 UTC).
steps_to_reproduce: 1) Login as a user from BrightCart in prod (us-east).
2) Open the embedded dashboard URL shared by the customer (iframe embed with org-scoped token).
3) Click a row's trace link (trace link is a console/panel generated URL with trace_id and session_nonce parameters).
4) Observe the browser response: 403 Forbidden for affected links while some other trace links resolve normally.
logs_and_errors: Edge logs (us-east): GET /traces/view?trace_id=abc123&session_nonce=xyz returned 403 (authorization: session nonce invalid)
Auth service: session_nonce validation failed: token not found in session-index (lookup returned 410 tombstone)
Retention job: compaction/GC logs 2026-03-12 03:12: Removed session-index keys with last_seen < 2026-01-10 (grace window applied)
comments: BrightCart Support (2026-03-12 07:45 UTC): Several of our analysts clicked trace links and got 403s; this started after your scheduled maintenance. We rely on trace drilldowns for incident demos — blocking.
Support (Maya Chen) (2026-03-12 08:05 UTC): Acknowledged, escalated to infra/console. Can you share one failing trace URL and a working one for comparison?
Customer (BrightCart) (2026-03-12 08:20 UTC): Provided two URLs and logs; attached in ticket.

SRE (Liam O'Connor) (2026-03-12 10:10 UTC): Investigating retention backfill interaction with session-index tombstones. Reproduced 403 locally with session_nonce that was removed by GC. Opening an ENG ticket to add a short-term rehydrate API.
investigation_notes: Hypothesis: Embedded dashboards generate trace links that include a 'session_nonce' parameter which relies on entries in the session-index datastore. During retention backfill/compaction, some session-index keys were tombstoned earlier than expected due to an off-by-one in grace-window calculation, causing validation to fail for links issued before backfill but used after.
Reproduction: Simulated retention GC on staging session-index; links with tombstoned nonces returned 403 with same auth error. Links without session_nonce (direct console links) continued to work.

Scope: Initial query shows ~12% of BrightCart's embedded-panel trace links from past 90 days reference nonces that were removed by the compaction window. Other orgs on same shard show <1% occurrence apparently due to different embed configuration.
Related artifacts: retention job logs (s3://retention-logs/prod/2026-03-12/compact.log), edge log samples, provided customer URLs.
root_cause: Retention compaction applied tombstone/grace-window thresholds using UTC day boundaries but session-index used org-local TTL rounding; resulting off-by-one caused recent-but-still-valid session nonces to be removed during backfill.
resolution: Mitigation (short-term): Added a temporary rehydration endpoint (internal) that accepts a trace link and looks up trace context via secondary indexes bypassing session_nonce if the nonce lookup returns a tombstone. Enabled for BrightCart org only at edge for immediate fix.

Workaround provided to customer: Use 'Open in Console' (direct) link from dashboard share instead of embedded trace link OR request reissue of embeds after rehydration (Support can run rehydrate task one-off).

Permanent fix: Patch retention GC to use consistent TTL rounding (PR open) and adjust graceful retention window + add canary checks before compaction. Also: deprecate session_nonce dependency for embedded public trace links — fallback to signed short-lived tokens embedded in the link.

Rollout plan: Retention GC patch scheduled for 2026-03-14 blue/green rollout. Rehydration endpoint to be removed after 30 days. Alerting: add pre-compaction audit that rejects compaction if >0.5% of recent embed-generated nonces would be removed.
